_extraction_notes.revenue_line_mapping: Oracle's GAAP income statement reports four revenue lines: 'Cloud services and license support' (combined cloud services + on-premise license support), 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (new license revenue), 'Hardware', and 'Services'. In this schema they are mapped as revenue.cloud = 'Cloud services and license support' and revenue.software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license', using Oracle's own reported figures verbatim (no re-allocation or estimation).
_extraction_notes.capex_sign_convention: capex_quarter and capex figures are stored as positive magnitudes (spend), consistent with the source press releases' Free Cash Flow tables. free_cash_flow_quarter = operating_cash_flow_quarter - capex_quarter.
_extraction_notes.tax_sign_convention: tax_provision is stored with the sign it carries in the income statement: a provision is negative and a benefit is positive, so that net_income = pretax_income + tax_provision in every period. FY2024Q1 is the only quarter with a net benefit (+$45M, printed as 'Benefit from (provision for) income taxes'); Q2-Q4 are provisions (negative).
_extraction_notes.quarterly_cash_flow_derivation: Oracle's Q2, Q3, and Q4 (and full-year) press releases present GAAP cash flow statements on a year-to-date (cumulative fiscal-year) basis, not discrete-quarter. Discrete quarterly operating cash flow and capex for Q2-Q4 were derived by subtracting the prior cumulative period (from the prior quarter's own 8-K Exhibit 99.1) from the current cumulative period, both sourced from Oracle's own SEC filings. Q1 figures are reported directly on a discrete 3-month basis. Cross-check: sum of the four derived/reported quarterly operating cash flows (6,974+143+5,475+6,081=18,673) equals the FY2024 full-year GAAP operating cash flow of $18,673M exactly, and sum of quarterly capex (1,314+1,080+1,674+2,798=6,866) equals FY2024 full-year capex of $6,866M exactly, and the resulting FY FCF of 11,807 matches the free-cash-flow trailing-4-quarter table printed in the Q4 exhibit ($11,807M) -- validating the derivation. Secondary check: the change in the trailing-4-quarter OCF between consecutive releases (e.g. 17,039 - 17,745 = -706 at Q2) equals the derived quarter minus the same quarter of FY2023 derived from the prior-year cumulative columns (143 - 849 = -706), confirming the low Q2 figure is as printed.
_extraction_notes.da_derivation: Depreciation and amortization of intangible assets are taken from the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income to net cash provided by operating activities' section of each exhibit's cash flow statement. Q1 is printed on a discrete 3-month basis; Q2, Q3 and Q4 cumulative (6-, 9- and 12-month) figures were converted to discrete quarters by subtracting the prior release's cumulative figures. Each release's cumulative figures are preserved in da.cumulative_as_printed. Cross-checks: quarterly depreciation 712+798+808+811 = 3,129 = FY2024 depreciation; quarterly amortization 763+755+749+743 = 3,010 = FY2024 amortization; and each quarter's derived amortization equals the 'Amortization of intangible assets' operating-expense line on that quarter's discrete income statement.
_extraction_notes.rpo_disclosure: Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) totals are disclosed in each press release only as rounded headline figures (e.g. '$98 billion'), not to the exact million, and no exact-dollar RPO figure appears elsewhere in the Exhibit 99.1 press releases. Values below are recorded in $ millions at the rounded precision disclosed (e.g. 98000 for '$98 billion') with the YoY % change as stated. The FY2024Q1 release contains no RPO figure at all (Oracle began headlining RPO in the Q2 FY2024 release), so rpo.total and rpo.yoy_change are null for Q1. The Q2 FY2024 release states 'over $65 billion' without a YoY %, so yoy_change is null for Q2.
_extraction_notes.guidance_disclosure: Oracle's Exhibit 99.1 earnings press releases for Q1-Q4 FY2024 do not contain a quantified forward-guidance table (no next-quarter revenue growth %, cloud growth %, or non-GAAP EPS range). Quantified guidance of this kind is given verbally on the earnings conference call (a separate document, not part of this 8-K exhibit) and was NOT extracted here to preserve strict SEC-filing sourcing. Qualitative forward-looking commentary from the CEO/Chairman quoted in each release is summarized in guidance_issued._note.
_extraction_notes.prior_year_comparatives: Only current-period columns were extracted. The FY2024 releases' prior-year (FY2023) comparative columns were not captured; where Oracle reclassified prior-period amounts (e.g. Cerner-related presentation changes), that affects only the comparative columns and not the current-period figures recorded here, which are as printed.
_extraction_notes.preferred_dividends: Oracle has no preferred stock outstanding in FY2024; preferred_dividends is 0 in all periods and net_income_common equals net_income.

source.title: Oracle Q1 FY2024 Earnings Press Release (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)

revenue._note: cloud = 'Cloud services and license support'; software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (Oracle's own line labels).

opex._note: restructuring_and_other = 'Acquisition related and other' ($11M) + 'Restructuring' ($138M), Oracle's two separate GAAP lines, combined per schema.

gaap._note: tax_provision is a net BENEFIT of $45M in this quarter (printed as 'Benefit from (provision for) income taxes'; GAAP effective tax rate (1.9%)), hence positive; net_income = 2,375 + 45 = 2,420.

cash_flow._note: Reported directly on a discrete three-months-ended Aug 31, 2023 basis in the Q1 exhibit. Press release text: 'Q1 operating cash flow was $7.0 billion, up 9%, and Q1 free cash flow was $5.7 billion, up 21%.'

da._note: Reported directly on a discrete three-months-ended basis in the Q1 exhibit's cash flow statement; no subtraction required. Amortization equals the income-statement 'Amortization of intangible assets' line ($763M).

rpo.note_en: No Remaining Performance Obligations figure is disclosed anywhere in the Q1 FY2024 Exhibit 99.1 (Oracle began headlining RPO in the Q2 FY2024 release). The only backlog-type statement is the Chairman's remark that AI development companies had signed contracts to purchase more than $4 billion of Gen2 Cloud capacity, twice the amount booked at the end of Q4 FY2023; this is not RPO and is not recorded as such.
rpo.note_es: El anexo 99.1 del 1T AF2024 no revela ninguna cifra de Obligaciones de Desempeno Restantes (Oracle comenzo a destacar el RPO en el comunicado del 2T AF2024). La unica declaracion de tipo cartera es el comentario del Presidente de que empresas de desarrollo de IA habian firmado contratos por mas de $4 mil millones de capacidad en la Nube Gen2, el doble de lo reservado al cierre del 4T AF2023; esto no es RPO y no se registra como tal.

guidance_issued._note: No quantified forward guidance is contained in this Exhibit 99.1 press release; Oracle communicates quarterly guidance verbally on its earnings conference call, which is a separate document not part of this 8-K exhibit. Qualitative forward-looking commentary only: CEO Safra Catz cited 66% OCI growth and the recurring 'Cloud Services plus License Support' stream now at 77% of total revenue; Chairman/CTO Larry Ellison stated AI development companies 'have signed contracts to purchase more than $4 billion of capacity in Oracle's Gen2 Cloud', twice the amount booked at the end of Q4 FY2023.

source.title: Oracle Q2 FY2024 Earnings Press Release (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)

revenue._note: cloud = 'Cloud services and license support'; software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (Oracle's own line labels).

cash_flow._note: Derived: Q2 exhibit reports cash flow on a six-months-ended Nov 30, 2023 cumulative basis (OCF $7,117M; capex $2,394M). Q2-only = six-month cumulative minus Q1's reported three-month figures (OCF $6,974M; capex $1,314M) from the Q1 8-K Exhibit 99.1. The low Q2 OCF is as printed and is corroborated by the exhibit's own trailing-4-quarter table, where TTM OCF fell from $17,745M (Q1) to $17,039M (Q2), a decline of $706M, equal to Q2 FY2024 ($143M) minus Q2 FY2023 ($849M, derived from the prior-year comparative columns 7,243 - 6,394); the six-month cash flow statement shows a $1,541M decrease in income taxes payable and a $1,048M decrease in accounts payable and other liabilities.

da._note: Derived: six-months-ended Nov 30, 2023 cumulative (depreciation $1,510M; amortization $1,518M) minus Q1's three-month figures (depreciation $712M; amortization $763M) from the Q1 8-K Exhibit 99.1. Derived amortization equals the discrete Q2 income-statement 'Amortization of intangible assets' line ($755M).

rpo.note_en: Total Remaining Performance Obligations 'over $65 billion', as stated in the press release headline and CEO quote ('climbed to over $65 billion -- exceeding annual revenue'). No year-over-year % change is disclosed in the exhibit; not disclosed to the exact million.
rpo.note_es: Las Obligaciones de Desempeno Restantes totales 'superan los $65 mil millones', segun el titular del comunicado y la cita de la CEO ('subieron a mas de $65 mil millones, superando los ingresos anuales'). El anexo no revela el cambio porcentual interanual; no se revela al millon exacto.

guidance_issued._note: No quantified forward guidance is contained in this Exhibit 99.1 press release. Qualitative commentary only: CEO Safra Catz stated Oracle's cloud businesses 'are now at nearly a $20 billion-dollar annual revenue run rate' and that 'cloud services demand continues to grow at unprecedented levels'; Chairman/CTO Larry Ellison stated Oracle is expanding 66 existing cloud datacenters and building 100 new ones, and that 'in the next few months, we are turning on 20 new Oracle cloud datacenters collocated with and connected to Microsoft Azure.' No quarterly revenue growth %, cloud growth %, or non-GAAP EPS range was disclosed in the exhibit itself.

source.title: Oracle Q3 FY2024 Earnings Press Release (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)

revenue._note: cloud = 'Cloud services and license support'; software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (Oracle's own line labels).

cash_flow._note: Derived: Q3 exhibit reports cash flow on a nine-months-ended Feb 29, 2024 cumulative basis (OCF $12,592M; capex $4,068M). Q3-only = nine-month cumulative minus Q2's cumulative six-month figures (OCF $7,117M; capex $2,394M) from the Q2 8-K Exhibit 99.1. Corroborated by the trailing-4-quarter table: TTM OCF rose $1,200M (17,039 to 18,239) = Q3 FY2024 ($5,475M) minus Q3 FY2023 ($4,275M, from prior-year comparative columns 11,518 - 7,243).

da._note: Derived: nine-months-ended Feb 29, 2024 cumulative (depreciation $2,318M; amortization $2,267M) minus Q2's six-month cumulative figures (depreciation $1,510M; amortization $1,518M) from the Q2 8-K Exhibit 99.1. Derived amortization equals the discrete Q3 income-statement 'Amortization of intangible assets' line ($749M).

rpo.note_en: Total Remaining Performance Obligations up 29% year-over-year to $80 billion ('over $80 billion -- an all-time record' in the CEO quote), as stated in the press release headline; CEO stated 43% of the $80 billion is expected to be recognized as revenue over the next four quarters. Not disclosed to the exact million in the exhibit.
rpo.note_es: Las Obligaciones de Desempeno Restantes totales aumentaron 29% interanual a $80 mil millones ('mas de $80 mil millones, un record historico' en la cita de la CEO), segun el titular del comunicado; la CEO indico que se espera reconocer como ingresos el 43% de los $80 mil millones durante los proximos cuatro trimestres. No se revela al millon exacto en el anexo.

guidance_issued._note: No quantified forward guidance is contained in this Exhibit 99.1 press release. Qualitative commentary only: CEO Safra Catz stated 'We expect that 43% of our current $80 billion of Remaining Performance Obligations will be recognized as revenue over the next four quarters, and that our Gen2 Cloud Infrastructure business will remain in a hypergrowth phase -- up 53% in Q3 -- for the foreseeable future,' and that Oracle expects to continue receiving large contracts reserving cloud infrastructure capacity because demand 'substantially exceeds supply'; Chairman/CTO Larry Ellison stated that in Q4 Oracle will start delivering its new Ambulatory Clinic Cloud Application Suite to Cerner customers. No quarterly revenue growth %, cloud growth %, or non-GAAP EPS range was disclosed in the exhibit itself.

source.title: Oracle Q4 & Full Year FY2024 Earnings Press Release (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)

revenue._note: cloud = 'Cloud services and license support'; software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (Oracle's own line labels).

cash_flow._note: Q4-only quarterly figures derived: FY2024 full-year cumulative (OCF $18,673M; capex $6,866M) minus Q3's cumulative nine-month figures (OCF $12,592M; capex $4,068M) from the Q3 8-K Exhibit 99.1. Full-year figures are reported directly in the Q4/FY exhibit's Year Ended May 31, 2024 cash flow statement. Cross-check: sum of all four quarters' operating cash flow (6,974+143+5,475+6,081) = 18,673 = FY total; sum of all four quarters' capex (1,314+1,080+1,674+2,798) = 6,866 = FY total; resulting FY free cash flow of $11,807M matches the Free Cash Flow - Trailing 4-Quarters table printed in this same exhibit exactly.

da._note: Derived: Year Ended May 31, 2024 cumulative (depreciation $3,129M; amortization $3,010M) minus Q3's nine-month cumulative figures (depreciation $2,318M; amortization $2,267M) from the Q3 8-K Exhibit 99.1. Derived amortization equals the discrete Q4 income-statement 'Amortization of intangible assets' line ($743M). Cross-check: four quarters' depreciation 712+798+808+811 = 3,129 and amortization 763+755+749+743 = 3,010, both equal to the full-year figures.

rpo.note_en: Q4 Total Remaining Performance Obligations up 44% year-over-year to $98 billion, as stated in the press release headline and CEO quote (not disclosed to the exact million in the exhibit). CEO also stated Oracle signed over 30 AI sales contracts totaling more than $12.5 billion in Q4, including one with OpenAI.
rpo.note_es: Las Obligaciones de Desempeno Restantes totales del 4T aumentaron 44% interanual a $98 mil millones, segun el titular del comunicado y la cita de la CEO (no se revela al millon exacto en el anexo). La CEO tambien indico que Oracle firmo mas de 30 contratos de venta de IA por mas de $12.5 mil millones en el 4T, incluido uno con OpenAI.

guidance_issued._note: No quantified next-quarter (Q1 FY2025) guidance table is contained in this Exhibit 99.1 press release. Initial FY2025 full-year outlook IS given, but only qualitatively (as direct CEO quotes), not as specific $ revenue or EPS figures: CEO Safra Catz stated 'Throughout fiscal year 2025, I expect continued strong AI demand to push Oracle sales and RPO even higher -- and result in double-digit revenue growth this fiscal year. I also expect that each successive quarter should grow faster than the previous quarter -- as OCI capacity begins to catch up with demand.' Chairman/CTO Larry Ellison stated 11 of the 23 OCI datacenters being built inside Azure went live in Q4, that Oracle signed an agreement with Google to interconnect clouds and initially build 12 OCI datacenters inside Google Cloud, and that 'We expect the Oracle database to be available within the Google Cloud in September this year.' These are the only FY2025 guidance-related statements in the exhibit; fy_total_revenue_at_least and fy_non_gaap_eps were not quantified and are left null per instructions rather than estimated.
